claim: ElastiCache for Valkey supports durability, which lets you use ElastiCache for both caching and data store workloads with microsecond read latency. Durability is currently supported with node-based ElastiCache.

evidence.quote: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey now supports durability. This capability enables you to use ElastiCache for both caching and data store workloads with microsecond read latency.
Durability is currently supported with node-based ElastiCache.
